description: Read the service files and reply with only the requested JSON object, which no progress or plan sentence may pollute
message: Read every service file under config/ and reply with only one JSON object that maps each service name to its port, such as {"alpha": 8080}. No plan, no summary, no code fence: the reply is the object and nothing else.

probes.text: the final reply is a single JSON object mapping alpha, beta and gamma to 8080, 8081 and 8082, with no other text
the reply text carries a progress or plan sentence
